comment: HH_260906 - Predeclare a cached scorer-only experiment before observing any new head training results.
relative_policy: Every paired seed must improve selected ADE and FDE versus its original C logits on the same cache, with no selected geometry regression and no speed MAE increase above five percent.
sampling_policy: All new arms share train._epoch_batches no-plan CPU randperm(seed+epoch). This differs from the historical original domain-aware order and is not claimed to reproduce it.
freeze_policy: Use each complete C checkpoint separately; freeze all model parameters and buffers in eval mode, cache context and predicted XY/speed without gradients, and hash them before and after head fitting. Never pool candidate indices across parent generators.
target_policy: Use the existing full composite trajectory_loss oracle and original XY/speed/yaw/valid targets. Labels and oracle metrics are never scorer inputs. No validation gradients, no early stopping and no held-out test evaluation.
comparison_limits: linear_continue versus original tests extra selector fitting; linear_reset controls fresh initialization; candidate_reset changes whole scorer depth/capacity/geometry inputs and is not a pure geometry-input causal test. All heads use fresh optimizer state, not exact resume.
deployment_policy: Head-only research checkpoint ID is rejected by normal train/evaluate/runtime loaders. No merged deployable model, runtime allowlist change, actuation or gate weakening. Preserve all failed outcomes and the deployed shadow model.
publication_notice: Redacted metadata view; replay requires the private original identified by raw_source_sha256.
